ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential fraud schemes in Minnesota, including the claim by David Hoch that the Minnesota DHS is backdating paperwork.
questions: What is the extent of the potential fraud in Minnesota?
How is the Minnesota DHS responding to the allegations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for greater oversight and transparency in state programs.
